(async()=>{const want=[0,1,3,4,6,7,8,11,13,16,17,26,68];const out=[];const b=document.querySelector('[data-testid=nav-next-btn]');if(!b||b.disabled)return false;for(let i=0;i<=68;i++){if(want.indexOf(i)>=0){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,90));out.push((function(){var el=document.querySelector('[data-testid=nav-picker-btn]');var g=document.querySelector('[data-testid=nav-picker-glyph-el]');if(!el)return '';var t=String(el.textContent);var gs=g?String(g.textContent):'';return (t.length>=gs.length?t.slice(gs.length):t).replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();})());}if(i<68){b.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,90));}}window.__rbTitles=out.join('|');return true;})()
